title: Towards Better Exploration in Sequential Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2609.39632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute at inference. However, both classes of existing methods often fail to continue improving over long timescales. Parallel methods repeatedly sample independent answers from the model, scaling poorly on problems the model is unlikely to solve in a single attempt. In contrast, sequential methods build on previous answers to access new ideas, yet so far have not been shown to reach answers beyond those found by parallel scaling. First, we show that sequential scaling often stops improving because it becomes prematurely trapped in an attractor: a set of answers that prevents exploration of different answers once entered. Across 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and benchmarks, we find that 53.8% of sequential scaling trajectories enter an attractor within four iterations. Second, we show that a simple model-mixing intervention helps escape attractors.

translated_title: 迈向序列测试时扩展中更好的探索
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过在推理时投入额外的计算来提升语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有的两类方法通常难以在长时间尺度上持续改进。并行方法反复从模型中采样独立的答案，在模型不太可能一次性解决的问题上扩展效果不佳。相比之下，序列方法在先前答案的基础上获取新想法，但迄今为止尚未被证明能够达到超越并行扩展所找到的答案。首先，我们表明序列扩展常常停止改进是因为它过早地陷入一个“吸引子”：一组一旦进入就会阻止探索不同答案的答案集合。在扩展方法、模型和基准测试的27种组合中，我们发现53.8%的序列扩展轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子。其次，我们展示了一种简单的模型混合干预方法有助于逃离吸引子。
tldr: 该论文揭示序列测试时扩展常因过早陷入“吸引子”（进入后阻止探索其他答案的答案集合）而停止改进——在27种方法、模型与基准的组合中53.8%的轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子——并提出一种简单的模型混合干预方法来帮助逃离吸引子，实现更好的探索。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that sequential test-time scaling often stalls due to premature entrapment in "attractors" — sets of answers that block exploration once entered, with 53.8% of trajectories entering an attractor within four iterations across 27 combinations of methods, models, and benchmarks — and proposes a simple model-mixing intervention to escape these attractors.
